messages:
mira: Partner asked for a compact security bundle for their marketplace listing. Required: redacted SOC, pen-test executive summary, KMS/HSM attestation, SAML metadata, and an artifacts retention excerpt. Can we assemble this by EOD?
sam: I can run SOC redaction today. Will remove customer names, IPs, and contract clauses. Need legal sign-off on the redaction list @legal-lisa.
owen: Pen-test vendor provided full report. Partner policy forbids POC sharing. I'll create a 1-page exec summary, list of affected components, and remediation ticket references. No raw exploit details.
tanya: For KMS/HSM attestation we have a short statement from infra plus HSM cert IDs. I can package that and include a screenshot of the KMS key policy.
legal-lisa: Confirming redaction scope: remove identifiable customer data and contract terms; keep findings taxonomy and remediation status. Offer full report under NDA via secure transfer.
evidence-bot: Auto: Created artifact bundle id=rb-1931234567-bundle.zip at s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/1931234567/. Default presign TTL=72h.
mira: Also partner asked whether SI connectors (SCIM/SAML) were in scope for the pen-test. Our external pen-test excluded 3rd-party hosted connectors; we should state that and offer targeted re-test if they require.
sam: Redaction command I'll run: `python redaction_tool.py --input soc2-2024.pdf --strip-names --strip-ips --output soc2-redacted-1931.pdf` ETA 6h.
owen: Draft pen-summary snippet:
```
Summary: 4 high/7 medium findings. Scope: external perimeter + internal API surface. SI connectors excluded from vendor scope. Remediations: ENG-1201, INF-3321, ETA Q2.
```
tanya: I'll add the KMS attestation link once uploaded. Also note: for private deployments we support HSM-backed keys; for hosted we rely on provider KMS with HSM protections.
legal-lisa: Add a short cover letter explaining what's redacted and next steps for requesting full artifacts. I'll approve the cover once I see the redaction diff.
evidence-bot: Auto: Presigned links created (placeholders):
- soc2-redacted: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/soc2-redacted-1931.pdf?sig=XXX (expires 72h)
- pen-summary: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/pen-summary-1931.pdf?sig=YYY (expires 72h)
- kms-attest: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/kms-attest-1931.pdf?sig=ZZZ (expires 72h)
mira: Planning call with partner scheduled Thu 11:00 PT. Please join if you can. Final action list: sam = SOC redaction + presign; owen = pen exec summary + ticket list; tanya = KMS/HSM attestation + screenshots; legal-lisa = redaction approval + cover note. I'll send the assembled package after legal sign-off.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll drop the presigned soc link in this thread when ready.
